samplesheet.description: S3 URI of a TSV with header cell_id<TAB>runs (comma-separated SRR accessions)

sra_prefix.description: S3 prefix (trailing /) holding staged runs as <SRR>/<SRR>

adapter.description: 3' adapter for cutadapt; default Tn5 mosaic end CTGTCTCTTATACACATCT
